title: Huntington Commercial Bank
meta_description: Introducing the new way to manage your organization's Huntington accounts.
full_description: With the new Huntington Commercial Banking app, manage your commercial accounts anytime, anywhere.View your deposit and savings accounts on the go. See critical details like debit and credit totals, current available balance, or 2 Day Float. Drill down to subaccounts or see the total current balance across subaccounts. That’s not all – as new features are rolled out, you’ll be able to update the app so you always have the latest-and-greatest mobile banking tools right at your fingertips.Get started with our app today. Message and data rates from your mobile carrier will still apply.System availability and response time are subject to market conditions.The Huntington National Bank is Member FDIC.
